_endpoint: GET /v1.0/shifts (time-off rows present alongside regular shifts)
_note: Humanity v1 surfaces time-off as a parallel record type with `type=time_off` and a different schedule_id field semantics. Adapter does NOT currently consume time-off rows for the canonical fact write — only `type=shift` (or unset, which defaults to shift) lands on the labor fact table. Time-off rows fall through HumanityShiftDto.tryFromMap because the parser does not branch on `type` but the row may have null position_name in some vendor responses (in which case sparse_no_role behavior applies); when position_name is set, adapter writes a normal shift fact and downstream pipeline treats time-off as zero-hours via business logic.
